caption: The drawing consists of a single horizontal rectangular strip positioned in the center of the page. The strip features a floral pattern with multiple large, overlapping flowers in shades of pale pink, light purple, and white, highlighted with touches of yellow. The flowers are surrounded by abundant, thick green foliage in gradients of light and dark green. The background of the strip is solid black, creating strong contrast with the colorful flowers and leaves. The edges of the strip are outlined with a thin green border. Below the strip, in the lower left corner of the page, the text "M. BANK" is printed or written in capital letters. The rest of the page is a blank, light beige color.
title: Wallpaper Border
